confidence_notes: Restaurant, cappuccino, and draft beer anchors use 2026 aggregated Sibiu typical-price data. Cocktail and wine estimates use their local price relationship to beer; accommodation is a less certain holistic estimate for July.
comparable_city_reasoning: Sibiu is assessed directly for food and drink. Accommodation is modeled against mid-sized Transylvanian and Eastern European historic tourism centers, allowing for July seasonal demand.
